title: Turning Movement Counts
description: One row of Replica's "Turning Movement Counts" dataset. Derived from the published schema table at https://documentation.replicahq.com/docs/turning-movement-counts-tmcs.

intersection_id_geom.description: Lat-long of the intersection in WKT POINT() format.

turn_maneuver.description: Maneuver at the intersection, such as left, right, through, u-turn.

inbound_heading.description: Heading of the inbound road described as degrees from north (0-360).

state.description: US state abbreviation indicating location of intersection.

inbound_stable_edge_id.description: A unique identifier for the network link.

inbound_street_name.description: The common name of the network link if available. Matches the name assigned by OpenStreetMap.

outbound_osm_id.description: A unique identifier for the OSM way or supersegment ID. Can be converted to a set of stable edge IDs.

outbound_street_name.description: The common name of the network link if available. Matches the name assigned by OpenStreetMap.

hour.description: Hour of day that the trip started, reported in the local time zone in 24-hour time format. Values in this field range between 0 and 23.

count.description: TMC counts scaled from observed numbers to match total volumes along network links.
